name: AZRedirect
description: Redirects users to the Azure AD login portal via the OpenID Connect Windows AAD module.
project_description:
Overview 

 This Azure login redirect module is used to automatically redirect users to the Microsoft login page when they access the site.

 Mandatory Modules 

 
 OpenID Connect Microsoft Azure Active Directory client 
 
 Module Installation 

 
 Install Module. 
 Enable the module at Administration > Extend. 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > AZ Redirect, then enable the 'Login Route' checkbox and Save configuration. After that, check the site in a private window or log out and try to access the site.
